key.name: hover-delay
key.description: How long the pointer must rest on an icon before the preview opens.

key.name: hide-delay
key.description: How long the preview stays open after the pointer leaves it.

key.name: current-workspace-only
key.description: Only preview windows on the active workspace.

key.name: current-monitor-only
key.description: Only preview windows on the monitor containing the hovered dock icon.

key.name: click-focused-minimizes
key.summary: Clicking the focused window minimizes it
key.description: Clicking the preview of the window that already has focus minimizes it instead.

key.name: middle-click-close
key.description: Middle-clicking a preview closes that window.

key.name: peek-on-hover
key.description: Resting on a preview fades out other windows so the window can be seen in place.

key.name: peek-delay
key.description: How long to rest on a preview before peeking.

key.name: show-media-controls
key.description: Show album art and play/pause/next buttons for apps playing media.

key.name: preview-size
key.description: Maximum width of each window thumbnail.

key.name: show-titles
key.description: Show the window title above each preview.

key.name: show-app-icon
key.description: Show the app icon next to each window title.

key.name: show-close-button
key.description: Show a close button on each preview.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Length of the open/close animation. 0 disables animations.
